question: Which Article of the Constitution of India prohibits anyone from employing children below the age of fourteen in factories, mines, etc?
solution:
The correct answer is __24__. 

__
 
• **Article 24__ **

 __
 
• **Article 24 of the Indian constitution talks about the prohibition of the employment of children in factories.**
 
• **No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Article 23

 
 
• Trafficking of humans and forms of forced labour are prohibited and any contravention of this provision shall be an offence punishable in accordance with the law.
 
• Nothing in this article shall prevent the State from imposing compulsory service for public purposes, and in imposing such service the State shall not make any discrimination on grounds only of religion, race, caste or class or any of them.
 
 
 
• Article 25: 
 
 
• Freedom of Conscience of the free profession, practice and propagation of religion.
 
 
 
• **Article 26:**
 
 
• Freedom to manage religious affairs.
 
 
 
• **Article 27:**
 
 
• Freedom from taxation for the promotion of religion.
 
 
 
• **Article 28:**
 
 
• Freedom from attending religious instruction.
 
 
 
• Article 34:
 
 
• Article 34 says while Martial Law is in force in any area, fundamental rights can be restricted.
 
 
 
• Article 21A:
 
 
• Article 21A provides the Right to Education.
 
• Under Article 21A State provides free and compulsory education to all children between the ages of 6 to 14 years.
 
 
 
• Article 31:
 
 
• Article 31 says the right to property is no more a fundamental right.
 
• The Right to property though still, is a constitutional right, not a fundamental right.
